description: A copy of the r-fmt-2b-w-accdb fixture (123 pages; page 122, Au4's old data page, is the only free page inside the file). Pg: tdef 52, usage maps 53 (owned {55, 56, 57}, FreeMap {57}), PK root 54, 12 plain rows of ID and eight Text(255) fields of 61 U+20AC (1004 bytes each, no long values); rows 1-4 fill page 55 (slots 0-3 at 0c14, 0828, 043c, 0050; 58 bytes free), 5-8 page 56, 9-12 page 57. Session 1 runs DELETE FROM Pg WHERE ID <= 4 (empties page 55, adding 55 to FreeMap with 4074 bytes free) and closes; session 2 runs DELETE FROM Pg WHERE ID >= 9 (empties page 57) and closes. Asks whether an already-empty lower FreeMap page from an earlier session causes emptied page 57 to be released. Each session opens the database shared read/write through DAO, runs its statements with dbFailOnError (RecordsAffected read), and closes, with the DBEngine alive. Reads keep pages 0, 1, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57 before and after (and hash pages 0-125 after each Close).
retentionNote: r-q20-delete-pages: WHERE/dynaset emptied-page release rule and deleted-row slot words on plain data pages
